part.text: The tests expect exactly one trailing newline to be stripped (a file with two trailing newlines keeps one). Let me implement that in replacer.go:

Fixed in replacer.go:403 — `file.*` replacements now strip a single trailing newline (and `\r` on Windows line endings) from file contents, so secrets stored with a trailing newline (per Unix convention) work correctly in placeholders like `{file./path/cool-secret}`. Both replacer tests pass, including the cases verifying that files with multiple trailing newlines retain the extra newlines.
